title: Owner-declared normalized benchmark index series v1
description: One immutable complete version, not raw security quotes. Runtime additionally requires UTF-8, unique JSON keys, canonical UTC, strictly increasing points no later than fetched_at, byte bounds, canonical decimals and a query/fragment/credential-free HTTPS provenance reference. Storage verification is not provider verification or data redistribution permission. Input and canonical JSON are each limited to 1 MiB.

label.description: At most 160 UTF-8 bytes, trimmed and without control characters.

source_reference.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes. Public provenance reference only; never fetched by this command. No credentials, query or fragment.

source_version.description: Owner file version; not a provider-verified revision or lexical freshness order. fetched_at is part of this version payload.

level.description: Exact nonnegative canonical decimal using the existing core decimal contract; zero is allowed and is not a valid future comparison denominator.

identity.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes; no Unicode whitespace or control characters.

timestamp.description: Canonical UTC RFC3339Nano; invalid dates and redundant fractional zeroes are rejected.
